text:
diane: starting onboarding for lapis-compact-v1 (512d) against our wiki+helpdesk corpus. objective: quick smoke for recall@1/5/10, cluster purity, and a short-query slice. launching 3k sample first.
jason: baseline?
diane: comparing to beacon-base-v2 and to tiny-lite-512 we used in last quarter. main hypothesis: smaller model keeps recall near parity for @5+ while saving memory.
tom: what quant configs?
diane: post-training int8 and a calibrated int4-perchannel trial. int4 is experimental.
priya: note — earlier compact models suffered specificity loss on short queries. add a prompt prefix ablation for short queries.
diane: initial int8 (dot, ivf) results on 3k:
Recall@1: lapis 0.64 | tiny-lite 0.69 | beacon 0.75
Recall@5: 0.85 | 0.88 | 0.91
Recall@10: 0.92 | 0.94 | 0.95
KMeans purity (k=60): lapis 0.60 | tiny-lite 0.63
Median intra-cluster cosine: 0.68 | 0.72
Average cluster size stdev: 9.8 | 8.6
jason: @1 drop but @5/@10 close. still worried about short queries. can you paste a few failing short queries?
diane: failures (query -> top1):
- "invoice status" -> "billing overview" (expected "invoice tracking")
- "wifi not working" -> "network settings" (expected "connectivity troubleshooting")
- "cancel my order" -> "returns policy" (expected "order cancellation")
priya: try L2 norm + cosine for kNN and also test prefixing short queries with \"Q:\" at embed time. small trick we've used.
tom: running cosine+norm job with prefix augmentation, batchsize=64. switching index to ivf_flat.
evalbot: queued job job_2026_03_22_lapis_01; sample=3k; configs=[lapis-int8-cosine-aug, lapis-int4-perch-rawdot, tiny-lite-int8]. ETA ~ 6m.
jason: also request UMAP for cluster 4/15 which looked messy in the staging figure.
diane: cosine+aug results:
Recall@1: 0.70
Recall@5: 0.87
Recall@10: 0.93
KMeans purity: 0.64
Median intra-cluster cosine: 0.71
Centroid drift vs tiny-lite: 0.04
diane: short-query top1 fixes: "invoice status" -> "invoice tracking", "wifi not working" -> "connectivity troubleshooting". augmentation + metric change helped.
priya: int4 run still bad: recall@1 0.58 @5 0.80. not acceptable for canary.
tom: infra note: check p50 latency with microbatch=32 after we promote; compact model should be faster but verify.
diane: plan: promote lapis-int8-cosine-aug to 5% canary, fallback to tiny-lite on recall@1 drop >0.04. add short-query promptset monitor and a cluster purity alert (purity <0.55). i'll open rollout PR with perf checks.
jason: +1. include evaluation hooks for multilingual slices too.
priya: will add promptset and run periodic 1k smoke every 6h during canary.
diane: thanks all, closing thread after PR. :shipit:
